proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C t
  have hD : (AffineMap.lineMap B C t : P) -ᵥ A = (1 - t) • (B -ᵥ A) + t • (C -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A]
    module
  rw [dist_comm A, dist_comm A B, dist_comm A C, dist_comm B C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V _ A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A,
    dist_eq_norm_vsub V C A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C B, hD, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A,
    norm_add_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs, real_inner_comm (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A)]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P) (t : ℝ), dist A (AffineMap.lineMap B C t : P) ^ 2 = (1 - t) * dist A B ^ 2 + t * dist A C ^ 2 - t * (1 - t) * dist B C ^ 2
